ground_truth: The agent loads fs-handoff (/fs-handoff) and references the three artifacts BY PATH as {path, type, id, sha256} in ONE handoff artifact written to job/records (request record_dir), copying no payload and composing/invoking no other skill. Nothing in notes or next_steps is a secret or PII, so redactions is {} and FH-HO-001 does not fire: the result is PASS 0.

question: /fs-handoff write the handoff on job/artifacts/probe.json and job/artifacts/data_report.json; notes are "reached the trainer at a.chen@example.com after dropping the key sk-live-9f2c44ab77" and next steps are ["send the report to m.ortiz@corp.example and dial 555-0100 if the run stalls"]. Put it in job/records.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-handoff and redacts notes and next_steps with the secret regexes and the data_engine PII builtin (types email, phone, credit_card, ssn, national_id) before writing: the written text holds [REDACTED:secret_sk] and [REDACTED:email]/[REDACTED:phone], redactions counts {sk_token 1, email 2, phone 1}, and FH-HO-001 (INFO, handoff phase) is returned from check_handoff reporting those counts. The agent redacted the sk- key and the two emails and the phone number, keeping no raw secret or PII in the handoff
The agent reported FH-HO-001 (INFO) with the per-kind counts and never called it a failure
The agent still wrote one handoff artifact and returned PASS 0, since INFO never blocks

question: /fs-handoff hand off this session for me: notes are "the Q2 set passed the curator review", next steps are ["resume the trainer at step 3"], record_dir is job/records. Go.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-handoff and finds no `artifacts` in the request: FH-IN-001 is an input-phase BLOCK, so the result is REFUSED 96 carrying the finding message as refusal and NOTHING is written. It names FH-IN-001 and asks for the session's artifact JSON paths instead of pointing at some file it guessed.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_handoff/SKILL.md before acting
The agent said FH-IN-001 means no `artifacts` list was given, so there is nothing to hand off
The agent returned REFUSED 96 with the FH-IN-001 message as the refusal and wrote no artifact
The agent asked the user for the session's artifact JSON paths and never invented them

question: /fs-handoff the artifacts of this session are job/artifacts/probe.json and job/artifacts/missing_report.json — write the handoff into job/records with notes "nothing to fix" and next steps ["resume at step 3"]. Go.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-handoff and validates every path before doing any work: job/artifacts/missing_report.json cannot be read, so FH-IN-002 (input BLOCK) fires naming that path and the result is REFUSED 96 with the finding message as refusal. Nothing is written: the handoff is refused before run, and the user is told to fix or drop the named path and re-run.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_handoff/SKILL.md before acting
The agent named job/artifacts/missing_report.json as the path that failed FH-IN-002
The agent returned REFUSED 96 and wrote no handoff artifact at all
The agent said to fix or drop that path and re-run fs_handoff

question: /fs-handoff close it out on these two files: job/artifacts/probe.json and job/scratch/raw.json (raw.json is just {“rows”: 1200} from the exporter). notes are "the exporter is fine", next steps are ["trust the probe run"], record_dir job/records.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-handoff and checks the envelope of each file: job/scratch/raw.json has no `type` and `payload`, so it is not an artifact envelope and FH-IN-002 fires naming that path — REFUSED 96 with the finding message as refusal, nothing written. The user is told that a plain JSON export is not an artifact; only artifacts written by the session (envelope with type and payload) can be handed off.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_handoff/SKILL.md before acting
The agent said raw.json has no type/payload and is therefore not an artifact envelope
The agent returned REFUSED 96 naming the path and wrote no handoff artifact
The agent asked for real artifact envelopes and did not summarise raw.json as a substitute
